Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media Expert position at ICF. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to support your client's social media team in achieving its objectives.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I also track performance using analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, which has honed my ability to interpret data and derive actionable insights. On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data and optimized content for both traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my commitment to staying ahead of digital trends.

I am skilled in social media content creation and integration, and I am comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams. My technical foundation in web design and analytics, combined with my proactive approach to learning, makes me well-suited to contribute to your social media strategies, campaign optimization, and reporting.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and I am available for opportunities in the region. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with your needs.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Expert position at ICF. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and analytics, I am eager to contribute to your client's social media team and help achieve their communication objectives.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a comprehensive skill set that directly aligns with the responsibilities outlined in your job description.
